pipelineStages.input: File object or { name: string, buffer: ArrayBuffer }
pipelineStages.transformation: Detects MIME type, selects adapter (pdfAdapter, docxExtractor, etc.), extracts raw text

pipelineStages.output: CanonicalAnalysisDocument { rawText, paragraphs, sentences, tokenCount, documentHash }
pipelineStages.transformation: Normalizes whitespace/line-endings, segments sentences/paragraphs, computes SHA-256 documentHash
Runs federationOrchestrator to retrieve candidates, calls analyzeDocumentEvidence in deterministicEngine.ts
Computes exact phrase / n-gram token overlap, derives sourceStart/sourceEnd integer offsets, emits findings
Filters out any finding whose matchedDocumentId does not belong to a verified source (provenanceState === 'VERIFIED')
Validates boundaries 0 <= start < end <= len, verifies slice text equality, merges overlapping ranges by precedence, walks text to emit contiguous slices

pipelineStages.output: JSX containing {seg.text}
pipelineStages.transformation: Maps segments to HTML5 mark elements and tooltip cards with source metadata
Renders document viewer inside Canonical Document Evidence Payload card

provenanceChain.formula: Canonical document -> authoritative finding -> authoritative source -> generated span -> rendered highlight

identityPreservation.findingId: Generated by deterministicEngine, passed through SimilarityFinding.findingId, bound to mark[data-finding-id]
identityPreservation.sourceId: Originates from academic provider candidate, verified in EvidenceMatch.sourceId, bound to SimilarityFinding.matchedDocumentId, bound to mark[data-source-id]
identityPreservation.textSlice: Direct string slice canonicalText.slice(start, end) without alteration or translation

offsetSpecification.intervalConvention: Half-open interval [startOffset, endOffset), start inclusive (0-indexed), end exclusive
offsetSpecification.normalizationPolicy: Offsets are calculated strictly against canonical normalized text post-G1 ingestion
offsetSpecification.overlapHandling: Overlapping ranges are merged in highlightUtils.ts using method precedence: EXACT_PHRASE (3) > NGRAM (2) > TOKEN_OVERLAP (1)
